title: Alpha Jet A (German light attack)

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The Alpha Jet A was the German Luftwaffe's close-support version of the Alpha Jet, with a head-up sight, Doppler navigation (a radar that measures the speed over the ground to keep track of the position) and a 27 mm gun pod. Its cockpit and controls are taken as those of the trainer, so this guide follows the Alpha Jet E guide.
